blind.description: A dark metal iron maiden torture device fashioned in a stylized upright humanoid form. It features a helmet-like head with a narrow visor slit, riveted iron reinforcing straps, side hinges, and a central padlock latch mechanism. The geometry is solid and continuous, standing securely on an integrated square metal plinth with dark wrought-iron and rusted metallic textures.
blind.from_above: A rounded oval dome with crossing riveted metal straps meeting at a central apex, with small hinge tabs protruding from the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: slightly shorter than the figure, approximately 5 feet tall, and about 2 feet wide at the base
